Multi English · 5th Grade · Theme 1

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece's school has a leader. He manages the school and works with all the teachers. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) headmaster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece's school has a leader. He manages the school and works with all the teachers.” Bu tarif “headmaster” kelimesine uyar; headmaster = okul müdürü. Diğer şıklar: English teacher (İngilizce öğretmeni), school nurse (okul hemşiresi), science teacher (fen bilimleri öğretmeni).

2

Selin sees a worker in the corridor. This person cleans the floors and keeps the school clean. The worker is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) cleaner

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin sees a worker in the corridor. This person cleans the floors and keeps the school clean.” Bu tarif “cleaner” kelimesine uyar; cleaner = temizlik görevlisi. Diğer şıklar: coach (antrenör), assistant to the headmaster (müdür yardımcısı), student (öğrenci).

3

Duru calls the school office. A woman answers the phone and takes a message for the headmaster. She is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) secretary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru calls the school office. A woman answers the phone and takes a message for the headmaster.” Bu tarif “secretary” kelimesine uyar; secretary = sekreter. Diğer şıklar: classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), school nurse (okul hemşiresi), English teacher (İngilizce öğretmeni).

4

Elif learns about plants and animals. Her teacher also explains experiments in the lab. This person is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) science teacher

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif learns about plants and animals. Her teacher also explains experiments in the lab.” Bu tarif “science teacher” kelimesine uyar; science teacher = fen bilimleri öğretmeni. Diğer şıklar: assistant to the headmaster (müdür yardımcısı), cleaner (temizlik görevlisi), student (öğrenci).

5

Nehir sits with her classmates for lessons. Their desks and the lesson board are in this room. It is their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) classroom

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir sits with her classmates for lessons. Their desks and the lesson board are in this room.” Bu tarif “classroom” kelimesine uyar; classroom = sınıf. Diğer şıklar: garden (bahçe), corridor (koridor), conference hall (konferans salonu).

6

Sena does a simple experiment with her teacher. They use special equipment in a room for science work. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) science lab

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena does a simple experiment with her teacher. They use special equipment in a room for science work.” Bu tarif “science lab” kelimesine uyar; science lab = fen laboratuvarı. Diğer şıklar: canteen (kantin), computer room (bilgisayar sınıfı), administration department (idari birim).

7

İpek goes outside during break time. She plays games in a safe area for children. She is in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) playground

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek goes outside during break time. She plays games in a safe area for children.” Bu tarif “playground” kelimesine uyar; playground = oyun alanı. Diğer şıklar: sports field (spor sahası), library (kütüphane), classroom (sınıf).

8

Eylül walks along a long indoor passage. Classroom doors open onto this passage. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) corridor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül walks along a long indoor passage. Classroom doors open onto this passage.” Bu tarif “corridor” kelimesine uyar; corridor = koridor. Diğer şıklar: canteen (kantin), administration department (idari birim), computer room (bilgisayar sınıfı).

9

Cemre enjoys colours and pictures. She joins a group to draw and paint after school. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) art club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre enjoys colours and pictures. She joins a group to draw and paint after school.” Bu tarif “art club” kelimesine uyar; art club = resim kulübü. Diğer şıklar: environment club (çevre kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü), chess club (satranç kulübü).

10

Melis likes acting on a stage. Her group practises a play and performs it for the school. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) drama club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis likes acting on a stage. Her group practises a play and performs it for the school.” Bu tarif “drama club” kelimesine uyar; drama club = tiyatro kulübü. Diğer şıklar: ballet club (bale kulübü), technology club (teknoloji kulübü), science club (fen kulübü).

11

Sıla enjoys watching films. Her group watches a film and talks about its story. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) film club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla enjoys watching films. Her group watches a film and talks about its story.” Bu tarif “film club” kelimesine uyar; film club = film kulübü. Diğer şıklar: folk dance club (halk oyunları kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü), chess club (satranç kulübü).

12

Defne enjoys numbers and problems. Her group solves number puzzles together. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) maths club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne enjoys numbers and problems. Her group solves number puzzles together.” Bu tarif “maths club” kelimesine uyar; maths club = matematik kulübü. Diğer şıklar: environment club (çevre kulübü), technology club (teknoloji kulübü), drama club (tiyatro kulübü).

13

Buse likes learning how things work. Her after-school group does experiments and studies nature. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) science club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse likes learning how things work. Her after-school group does experiments and studies nature.” Bu tarif “science club” kelimesine uyar; science club = fen kulübü. Diğer şıklar: film club (film kulübü), folk dance club (halk oyunları kulübü), ballet club (bale kulübü).

14

İdil's class needs silence for a listening task. The teacher wants everyone to stop talking. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Be quiet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil's class needs silence for a listening task. The teacher wants everyone to stop talking.” Bu tarif “Be quiet” kelimesine uyar; Be quiet = Sessiz ol. Diğer şıklar: Don't eat in the classroom (Sınıfta yemek yeme), Don't be late (Geç kalma), Don't be rude (Kaba olma).

15

Zeynep's lesson starts now. Her teacher wants everyone to look at page ten in their books. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Open your book

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep's lesson starts now. Her teacher wants everyone to look at page ten in their books.” Bu tarif “Open your book” kelimesine uyar; Open your book = Kitabını aç. Diğer şıklar: Don't run in the corridor (Koridorda koşma), Close the door (Kapıyı kapat), Obey the rules (Kurallara uy).

16

Mina speaks rudely to a new student. Her teacher wants her to speak nicely and care about others. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Be kind

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina speaks rudely to a new student. Her teacher wants her to speak nicely and care about others.” Bu tarif “Be kind” kelimesine uyar; Be kind = Kibar ol. Diğer şıklar: Wear your uniform (Üniformanı giy), Don't be late (Geç kalma), Be quiet (Sessiz ol).

17

Pelin opens a sandwich during the lesson. Her teacher wants her to save the food for the eating area. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Don't eat in the classroom

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin opens a sandwich during the lesson. Her teacher wants her to save the food for the eating area.” Bu tarif “Don't eat in the classroom” kelimesine uyar; Don't eat in the classroom = Sınıfta yemek yeme. Diğer şıklar: Open your book (Kitabını aç), Close the door (Kapıyı kapat), Don't run in the corridor (Koridorda koşma).

18

Derya speaks in a very loud voice. Her teacher wants her to lower her voice instead of yelling. She says, "______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Don't shout

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya speaks in a very loud voice. Her teacher wants her to lower her voice instead of yelling.” Bu tarif “Don't shout” kelimesine uyar; Don't shout = Bağırma. Diğer şıklar: Be kind (Kibar ol), Wear your uniform (Üniformanı giy), Obey the rules (Kurallara uy).

19

Sena's uncle lives in Berlin. He speaks German with his neighbours. He lives in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Germany

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's uncle lives in Berlin. He speaks German with his neighbours.” Bu tarif “Germany” kelimesine uyar; Germany = Almanya. Diğer şıklar: Azerbaijan (Azerbaycan), Thailand (Tayland), South Korea (Güney Kore).

20

Eda's friend lives in London. This city is in the English part of the United Kingdom. Her friend lives in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) England

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda's friend lives in London. This city is in the English part of the United Kingdom.” Bu tarif “England” kelimesine uyar; England = İngiltere. Diğer şıklar: Australia (Avustralya), Brazil (Brezilya), Greece (Yunanistan).

21

Cem visits Madrid on holiday. He hears people speak Spanish in the city. He is in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Spain

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem visits Madrid on holiday. He hears people speak Spanish in the city.” Bu tarif “Spain” kelimesine uyar; Spain = İspanya. Diğer şıklar: Russia (Rusya), Canada (Kanada), Mexico (Meksika).

22

Eren has a friend in Beijing. His friend speaks Chinese at school. The friend lives in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) China

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren has a friend in Beijing. His friend speaks Chinese at school.” Bu tarif “China” kelimesine uyar; China = Çin. Diğer şıklar: Italy (İtalya), Scotland (İskoçya), Japan (Japonya).

23

Baran visits Cairo with his family. They see the famous pyramids near the city. They are in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Egypt

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran visits Cairo with his family. They see the famous pyramids near the city.” Bu tarif “Egypt” kelimesine uyar; Egypt = Mısır. Diğer şıklar: France (Fransa), Singapore (Singapur), Argentina (Arjantin).

24

Tolga's school has a celebration on 29 October. Students carry Turkish flags and sing songs. They celebrate ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Republic Day

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga's school has a celebration on 29 October. Students carry Turkish flags and sing songs.” Bu tarif “Republic Day” kelimesine uyar; Republic Day = Cumhuriyet Bayramı. Diğer şıklar: Victory Day (Zafer Bayramı), Eid al-Adha (Kurban Bayramı), Germany (Almanya).

25

Ozan's family celebrates at the end of Ramadan. They visit relatives and give sweets to children. They celebrate ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Eid al-Fitr

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's family celebrates at the end of Ramadan. They visit relatives and give sweets to children.” Bu tarif “Eid al-Fitr” kelimesine uyar; Eid al-Fitr = Ramazan Bayramı. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), secretary (sekreter), Italy (İtalya).

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can learns English words and songs. A woman helps him speak and read in English.” Bu tarif “English teacher” kelimesine uyar; English teacher = İngilizce öğretmeni. Diğer şıklar: science teacher (fen bilimleri öğretmeni), cleaner (temizlik görevlisi), headmaster (okul müdürü).

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) music club

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

headmaster

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) okul müdürü

“headmaster” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okul müdürü” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The headmaster is in his office.

2

school nurse

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) okul hemşiresi

“school nurse” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okul hemşiresi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The school nurse helps sick students.

3

cleaner

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) temizlik görevlisi

“cleaner” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “temizlik görevlisi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul çalışanları” grubundandır. Örnek: The cleaner cleans the classrooms.

4
